note: The old test's last arm: two acknowledgements of one issue refuse the build (old: ValueError matching 'acknowledged twice', for the same case under a second case id). Both entries name member 1003's unresolved catalog identity by the same code, subject, refs, fields and period, and differ only in their reason, so the register file loads (an exact repeat is refused earlier, as register_duplicate_entry). The refusal is the located register_duplicate_entry, the code of that exact repeat, naming the second entry and the first entry it repeats (until the located-errors fix it was a plain ValueError, reported as pipeline_build_failed). Allowed twin: `acknowledge-guarded-by-its-unchanged-original-rows`, whose one entry for the same issue acknowledges it; the old test's other assertions live there.
fails_if: `resolve_source_scope` (source_scope.py) stops refusing a second acknowledgement of a held issue key (for example the later entry overwrites the first in `held`), so the build completes and one of the two entries silently acknowledges the issue; or it refuses without the located `register_duplicate_entry` naming both entries
